message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) from list based on facts.

Facts: Defendant set fire to property (corn husk, corn cobs, then house interior) causing damage valued 17905 yuan. This is intentional arson? The list includes "放火" (arson) and "故意毁坏财物" (intentional destruction of property). In examples, when someone uses a lighter to set fire intentionally, they used "放火". For example: the case with Wuhan Han Yang district: used lighter to set bedding on fire, resulting in fire, answer: 放火. Also case with Wu in Hangzhou: used lighter to set fire, answer: 放火. Also case with "失火" is used when fire caused unintentionally (e.g., accidental fire due to negligence). So here the defendant intentionally set fire to cause damage. So the appropriate charge is "放火". Also could be "故意毁坏财物"? But examples show that when fire is intentional, they use 放火. So answer: [罪名]放火<eoa>.

Check list: "放火" is present. So final answer.
